newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Hylsamex upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hylsamex upgraded to buy.

text.p: Santander Investment said Monday it upgraded Mexican steel company Hylsamex to buy from market perform.
"Santander expects the steel producer to report earnings per share of 3.55, 5.41 and 10.42 pesos in 1997, 1998 and 1999, respectively, versus 1996 earnings of 8.50," Santander said in a statement.
Santander said Hylsamex's planned expansion of its mini-mill steel lines should increase operating profits.
"Santander anticipates a target price of $33.20 per ADR (ADR ratio 6:1), implying 31 percent upside," the company added.
